en.topic_title: Hong Kong International Airport sees 10.2% growth in September passenger traffic

zh.topic_title: Hong Kong International Airport sees 10.2% growth in September passenger traffic

en.topic_title: Hong Kong International Airport sees 10.2% growth in September passenger traffic
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong International Airport (HKIA) has said it handled 4.86 million passengers in September – up 10.2 per cent from the same period last year – thanks to strong upticks in transit passengers and visitors from mainland China.



Hong Kong International Airport. File photo: GovHK.



The Airport Authority said on Tuesday that there was “steady growth across all key traffic areas” last month, with flights growing seven per cent to over 32,000 and cargo volume increasing
